browserUiZoom.method: Installed GUI Chrome 154 in an isolated temporary profile. Opened chrome://settings/appearance, selected the browser UI Zoom menu item 200%, then loaded the local ZUR landing page in that profile. No CDP device-metrics or page-scale emulation was applied.
browserUiZoom.interpretation: Chrome browser zoom halves the CSS layout width against the 1536 CSS-pixel outer window. DPR 2.5 includes the session's 1.25 display scale multiplied by 200% browser zoom; visualViewport scale remains 1, distinguishing browser zoom from pinch zoom.
browserUiZoom.visualInspection: At the measured 200% browser zoom, the landing page's header, two-line hero, paragraph, and primary/secondary actions remain readable and fit the viewport width; lower content scrolls vertically.
